skill.summary: Generates tailored side project ideas and plans that demonstrate your target role skills within your time and resource constraints.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Side Project Portfolio Builder.
- Designs portfolio side projects tailored to target roles and specified skills.
- Focuses on manageable project scope and clear success criteria.
- Ensures safe, ethical, and realistic project recommendations.
- Provides structured output: project concepts, MVP scope, plan, and write-up outline.
